notesForDeepResearch: Verify whether any committed competitor event has documented overflow hotels, shuttle overflow, ancillary meetings or external catering needs.

For Festopia and The Trip, verify contracting entity, inventory allocation and cancellation/overflow terms.
materialUncertainties: All six candidates name a competing resort; none is evidence of open inventory for Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana.
No candidate has a published peak-room figure.
The public evidence is strongest for Hard Rock, Barceló and Paradisus; the RIU item requires hotel-allocation verification.
No qualifying edition-specific future commitment was found in the reviewed material for Lopesan Costa Bávaro, TRS Turquesa, Grand Palladium Punta Cana, Meliá Punta Cana Beach or Royalton Punta Cana.

result.text: Six future, edition-specific competitor-hosted opportunities were identified in Punta Cana for 2027. The strongest are the Hard Rock-hosted WSOP, SLAP, and SODOCARDIO programmes; Festopia and the Circle by Meliá Golf Challenge also have explicit resort/package evidence. The RIU opportunity is included with targeted verification because the public page does not conclusively establish the Palace room allocation. None is treated as open inventory for Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana.
